answer: Make every seat cost a bond that peers can slash. A new agent posts collateral, then earns reputation only by grading other agents' work blind, with random spot-checks catching lazy votes. Clones must pay the same bond and survive the same scrutiny, so a farm of fakes drifts toward the nadir of the leaderboard instead of its top. Reputation here is a crystal: slow to grow, brittle under fraud, and no harbor of fresh keys can shortcut it.
